cases.note: Proposal Section 6.4 specifies atomic lease queuing and exponential backoff retry up to 300s.

cases.expected: If SQLite lease is acquired but cookie mirroring fails, release the lease immediately so the domain is not locked for 120s TTL.
If the user logged into the ATS in their visible Chrome after ShadowMux started, re-sync cookies before navigating.
If network drops mid-autofill, abort before Submit, release the ShadowMux lease, and offer a retry without risking partial form submission.

cases.note: Proposal Section 6.3 defines an 8.0s selector timeout that falls back to screenshot + Telegram HITL alert.

cases.expected: If the ATS returns 4xx/5xx or rejects the PDF upload format/size, capture the error banner screenshot and notify Telegram.
Check the local applications ledger (UNIQUE job_id) and disable the Telegram 1-Tap Apply button immediately after first confirmation.
If fields fill but file upload fails, escalate to HITL with the partial form intact rather than submitting without a resume.
Verify the requisition is still open (not 404/closed) before filling; if closed overnight, mark expired and surface tomorrow's #2 role.
Never blindly retry Submit after a network drop; check ATS confirmation email/page state first or escalate to human verification.
After clicking Submit, poll up to 30s for confirmation; on timeout, save a screenshot and mark status='uncertain_needs_check' instead of failing.
Parse inline ATS validation errors (e.g. invalid phone format) and route to HITL instead of generic failure.

cases.note: Only confirmation scraping and local SQLite stamping happen after the form is validated and submitted.
